name: lumen-lights
description: One dark-mode control center for WiZ, GE Cync and Hubspace smart lights
author: Lumen

scripts.test: node test/run.js && node test/show.js && node test/effects.js && node test/av.js

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Lumen listens to audio only to measure loudness for music-reactive lighting.
extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: Lumen measures system sound loudness for music-reactive lighting. Nothing is recorded or sent anywhere.
extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: Lumen can use the camera to calibrate light timing. Nothing is recorded or sent anywhere.
extendInfo.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Lumen talks to smart lights on your local network.
